{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99) after cleaning
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99) in completed set: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for any suspiciously high values (e.g., > 100,000)
high_value_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] > 100000]
print(f"Number of orders with revenue > $100,000: {len(high_value_orders)}")

# Show the values of suspicious orders
print("Revenue values > $100,000:", high_value_orders['revenue_numeric'].tolist())"}
